notes.title: Version 1.1.0 update and release of free original soundtrack package
notes.notes:
[h1]Content Update for Version 1.1.0[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added several debt repayment missions, allowing players to gain catgirl affection by repaying debts, facilitating faster unlocking of character backstories and acquiring new bonuses.
[*]Introduced a new cooking option in the kitchen. Players can now cook at the stove behind the dining table, unlocking recipes based on previously obtained food items and crafting them with certain ingredients.
[*]Fixed several bugs, including UI layering issues, font errors, and some crash problems.
[*]Added cloud save functionality, enabling players to upload save files to Steam Cloud.
[*]A new free original soundtrack pack has been released, containing all the music from the game, and players can redeem it for free.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206230/_Soundtrack]OST[/url]
[*]......
[/list]

1.0.6.1 update

1.The gift confirmation has been updated. Now players will have a confirmation option when giving gifts to the cat girls.
2.The option to enable or disable furniture effects has been updated. When there are a large number of furniture items, players can choose to disable furniture effects to optimize frame rates.
3.Fixed a bug where some plots were not getting wet when cultivating multiple plots during rainy days.
4.Increased the price for upgrading the sickle and added a new golden sickle feature. Now, the golden sickle can harvest all crops within its range.

Fixed the problem that the passage cannot be passed after completing the first debt repayment task.

notes.title: Game Demo Update: Fixed bugs and added two new maps
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after some preparation, we have finally completed the development of this version before the arrival of the New Product Festival. Thank you for your support! There will also be games to participate in the upcoming New Product Festival. We hope everyone can come and play at that time!
Here is the content of this update, I hope everyone has a good time!
[b]New content[/b]
[list]
[*] New tasks have been added. Now that the player's debt repayment reaches 30000, the fast lane from the farm to the beach will be unlocked. If it reaches 60000, the map's highland mining area will be unlocked. If the repayment reaches 100000, the fast lane from the riverside forest to the highland mining area will be unlocked
[*] Added two types of mushrooms that can be harvested on farms and in the wild, as well as four types of shells that can be washed ashore on the beach
[*] Added dialogue bubbles for cats
[*] Some tasks now require players to hand over task items to the cat lady in order to be considered completed
[*] Now there is a time limit for entering and exiting the rooms of the cats
Now players can have breakfast and dinner with the cats (pay attention to dining time)
[*]
[/list]
[b]Fix Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to mine blank spaces in certain special situations
[*] Fixed the issue where the timed gain of some foods could not be triggered correctly
[*] Fixed some document translation issues
[*] Fixed some UI hierarchy issues
[*] Optimized game feel
[*]
[/list]
Finally, thank you very much to our friends for their fun and feedback! [img] {STEAL_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899117/42dbf0812f3cb82bc98bbefd619f326e9ac7440a. png [/img]

notes.title: 【Game Update】Added new content and fixed a series of bugs.
notes.notes:
First and foremost, we are extremely grateful to all the players who have provided suggestions and feedback for the game!

Here are the details of the latest update:

[b]1. Added beginner guidance quests[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fishing series quests
[*] Logging series quests
[*] Mining series quests
[*] Shop series quests
[*] ...
[/olist]

[b]2. Added a game map[/b]
Players can now view the game map in their inventory. The map shows the general terrain of the entire Cat Island and displays the current player's location in real-time.

[b]3. Optimized the game controls[/b]
The animation speed for actions like chopping trees and mining has been improved, making the gameplay smoother.

[b]4. Balanced some numerical values[/b]
Skill level upgrades are now easier for players. The costs for gaining buffs have been reduced to 1500, 3000, 4500, and 6000. There are now more minerals in the farm.

[b]5. Checked and corrected English translations[/b]
Based on feedback from some English-speaking players, we have corrected the English translations, fixing translation errors and untranslated text.

[b]6. Fixed a series of bugs[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue of characters shaking when moving too fast
[*] Fixed the issue of the game freezing when clicking with the mouse during a black screen
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to fish in a vertical direction
[*] Fixed the issue of the backpack button still being usable in the tool interface
[*] Fixed the issue of NPC animations continuing to play when the game is paused
[*] Fixed the issue of negative gold coins after repaying debts
[*] Fixed the issue of wheat repeatedly refreshing
[*] ...
[/olist]

Lastly, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the players for your support and feedback!

notes.title: The Demo of "Farm Debt Repayment Story" will be launched within a week.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899117/38c94daec7d530292b9323773dedfe6509a5263c.png[/img]
I'm delighted to be part of this Farm Management Game Festival. We will be releasing a free demo version of our game within the festival duration (within a week), allowing players to experience a unique farming game.

Unlike traditional farming games, players in "Farm Debt Repayment Story" start with a huge debt, and interest accumulates daily (just like in real life!). But don't worry, you have numerous strategies and tools to tackle this. These include rational borrowing to secure initial funds for rapid development and avoiding a growing debt. You can invest some funds to gain bonuses that rapidly enhance resource acquisition capabilities, such as increasing the value of agricultural products, catching extra fish while fishing, significantly reducing the brewing time for beverages, and greatly shortening the growth time for crops, to name a few.

Moreover, the game features over 20 types of crops, 30 species of fish, and more than 100 delicious dishes to restore players' energy. With these powerful tools, we believe players can rely on their hard work and wisdom to repay this huge debt!

We hope you will come and experience it during the festival. Thank you for your continued support! (Don't forget to add it to your wishlist~)
